---
title: "Sky and events"
subtitle: "Smooth planetary motion above, bursty recorded events below"
description: "Sidereal longitudes of the nine grahas, 1976-2026, linked to the Himalayan-arc earthquake catalogue or to gold and silver extreme-move days."
---

The upper panel is the sky: the sidereal (Lahiri) longitude of each graha,
sampled once a month from the project's ephemeris engine. The lower panel is a
record of events: Himalayan-arc earthquakes above the completeness threshold
(USGS), or the days on which gold or silver moved more than its own recent
95th percentile. The shaded bands are the times an indicator from the study's
pre-registration was active.

::: {.af-howto}
**How to read this.** Brush (drag across) either panel to select a span of
time; the other panel follows, and the counts below the chart update. Events
drawn in orange happened while the selected indicator was active, blue ones
while it was not. A relationship, if one exists, would show as orange events
packed more densely inside the bands than blue events outside them; the
numbers below the chart say how dense, and the gauge shows the registered
test from the study, which accounts for the length of time each indicator is
active. The planets move smoothly and predictably; the events do not. Switch
the sky panel to the zodiac wheel to see the sky at the end of the brushed
span.
:::

```{ojs}
eph = FileAttachment("../data/ephemeris_monthly.json").json()
eq = FileAttachment("../data/earthquake.json").json()
gold = FileAttachment("../data/market_gold.json").json()
silver = FileAttachment("../data/market_silver.json").json()
res = FileAttachment("../data/results.json").json()
```

::: {.af-filters}

```{ojs}
viewof series = Inputs.select(new Map([
  ["Earthquakes, Himalayan arc (USGS)", "earthquake"],
  ["Gold: extreme-move days", "gold"],
  ["Silver: extreme-move days", "silver"]
]), { label: "Event series" })
```

```{ojs}
viewof catalogue = Inputs.radio(new Map([["Raw", "raw"], ["GK", "gk"], ["NN", "nn"]]), {
  label: "Catalogue", value: "gk", disabled: series !== "earthquake"
})
```

```{ojs}
indicatorOptions = series === "earthquake" ? eq.indicators : (series === "gold" ? gold : silver).indicators
viewof indicator = Inputs.select(new Map(indicatorOptions.map((d) => [d.label, d.id])), { label: "Indicator" })
```

```{ojs}
viewof dateFrom = Inputs.date({ label: "From", value: "1976-01-01", min: "1976-01-01", max: "2026-10-31" })
```

```{ojs}
viewof dateTo = Inputs.date({ label: "To", value: "2026-10-31", min: "1976-01-01", max: "2026-10-31" })
```

```{ojs}
viewof view = Inputs.radio(["Line", "Polar wheel"], { label: "Sky panel", value: "Line" })
```

:::

```{ojs}
viewof planets = Inputs.checkbox(new Map(PLANETS.map((d) => [d.name, d.id])), {
  label: "Planets", value: ["MARS", "SATURN", "KETU"]
})
```

```{ojs}
market = series === "gold" ? gold : series === "silver" ? silver : null
indicatorSpec = indicatorOptions.find((d) => d.id === indicator) || indicatorOptions[0]
monthIdx = eph.columns.month.map((m, i) => ({ date: new Date(m + "-01T00:00:00Z"), i }))
  .filter((r) => r.date >= dateFrom && r.date <= dateTo)
skyRows = planets.flatMap((id) => unwrapRows(monthIdx.map((r) => ({
  date: r.date, id, lon: eph.columns[id][r.i], retro: eph.columns[id + "_r"][r.i] === 1
}))))
events = {
  if (series === "earthquake") {
    const c = eq.events;
    return c.time.map((t, i) => ({
      date: new Date(t + ":00Z"), mw: c.mw[i], lat: c.lat[i], lon: c.lon[i],
      active: c[indicator][i] === 1, keep: catalogue === "raw" || c[catalogue][i] === 1
    })).filter((d) => d.keep && d.date >= dateFrom && d.date <= dateTo);
  }
  const c = market.columns;
  return c.date.map((t, i) => ({
    date: new Date(t + "T00:00:00Z"), extreme: c.extreme[i],
    move: c.sign[i] > 0 ? "up" : "down", active: c[indicator][i] === 1
  })).filter((d) => d.extreme === 1 && d.date >= dateFrom && d.date <= dateTo);
}
windows = {
  let runs = [];
  if (series === "earthquake") {
    runs = (eq.windows[indicator] || []).map(([a, b]) => [new Date(a + ":00Z"), new Date(b + ":00Z")]);
  } else {
    const c = market.columns;
    runs = runsOf(c.date.map((t) => new Date(t + "T00:00:00Z")), c[indicator]);
  }
  return runs.filter(([a, b]) => b >= dateFrom && a <= dateTo)
    .map(([a, b]) => ({ a: a < dateFrom ? dateFrom : a, b: b > dateTo ? dateTo : b }));
}
```

```{ojs}
viewof brushSel = {
  const w = Math.max(340, Math.min(width, 1200));
  const margins = { marginLeft: 56, marginRight: 44, marginTop: 12, marginBottom: 32 };
  const x = { type: "utc", domain: [dateFrom, dateTo], label: null };
  const band = () => Plot.rect(windows, {
    x1: "a", x2: "b", fill: palette.active, fillOpacity: 0.22
  });
  const info = (id) => palette.planetInfo(id);
  const panels = [];
  if (view === "Line") {
    const last = d3.groups(skyRows.filter((d) => Number.isFinite(d.lon)), (d) => d.id)
      .map(([, v]) => v[v.length - 1]);
    panels.push(Plot.plot({
      ...margins, marginTop: 28, width: w, height: 316, style: plotStyle,
      x, y: { domain: [0, 360], ticks: d3.range(0, 361, 30), grid: true, label: "Sidereal longitude (deg)" },
      color: { type: "identity" },
      marks: [
        band(),
        Plot.line(skyRows.filter((d) => !info(d.id).dashed), {
          x: "date", y: "lon", z: "id", stroke: (d) => palette.planet(d.id), strokeWidth: 1.5
        }),
        Plot.line(skyRows.filter((d) => info(d.id).dashed), {
          x: "date", y: "lon", z: "id", stroke: (d) => palette.planet(d.id), strokeWidth: 1.5,
          strokeDasharray: "4 3"
        }),
        Plot.text(last, {
          x: "date", y: "lon", text: (d) => info(d.id).abbr, dx: 6, textAnchor: "start",
          fill: palette.ink, fontWeight: 600
        }),
        Plot.tip(skyRows.filter((d) => Number.isFinite(d.lon)), Plot.pointer({
          x: "date", y: "lon",
          title: (d) => `${info(d.id).name}: ${d.lon.toFixed(1)} deg${d.retro ? ", retrograde" : ""}\n${d.date.toISOString().slice(0, 7)}`
        }))
      ]
    }));
  }
  const quake = series === "earthquake";
  panels.push(Plot.plot({
    ...margins, width: w, height: quake ? 220 : 160, style: plotStyle, x,
    y: quake ? { label: "Magnitude (Mw)", grid: true, nice: true }
             : { domain: ["up", "down"], label: "Move" },
    color: { type: "identity" },
    marks: [
      band(),
      quake
        ? Plot.dot(events, {
            x: "date", y: "mw", r: 4, fill: (d) => (d.active ? palette.active : palette.inactive),
            stroke: palette.surface, strokeWidth: 1.5,
            title: (d) => `${d.date.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace("T", " ")} UTC\nMw ${d.mw}  (${d.lat}, ${d.lon})\n${indicatorSpec.label}: ${d.active ? "active" : "not active"}`,
            tip: true
          })
        : Plot.tickX(events, {
            x: "date", y: "move", stroke: (d) => (d.active ? palette.active : palette.inactive), strokeWidth: 2,
            title: (d) => `${d.date.toISOString().slice(0, 10)}: extreme ${d.move} move\n${indicatorSpec.label}: ${d.active ? "active" : "not active"}`,
            tip: true
          })
    ]
  }));
  const root = htl.html`<div class="af-chart" id="sky-events-chart">${panels}</div>`;
  root.value = null;
  const scale = panels[0].scale("x");
  const extent = (svg) => [[margins.marginLeft, margins.marginTop],
    [w - margins.marginRight, +svg.getAttribute("height") - margins.marginBottom]];
  const brushes = panels.map((svg) => {
    const brush = d3.brushX().extent(extent(svg));
    const g = d3.select(svg).append("g").attr("class", "af-brush");
    return { svg, brush, g };
  });
  const dim = (sel) => {
    for (const { svg } of brushes) {
      d3.select(svg).selectAll("g[aria-label=dot] circle, g[aria-label=tickX] line").each(function () {
        const px = +(this.getAttribute("cx") ?? this.getAttribute("x1"));
        this.style.opacity = !sel || (px >= sel[0] && px <= sel[1]) ? 1 : 0.18;
      });
    }
  };
  for (const b of brushes) {
    b.brush.on("brush end", (event) => {
      if (!event.sourceEvent) return;
      const sel = event.selection;
      for (const o of brushes) if (o !== b) o.g.call(o.brush.move, sel);
      dim(sel);
      root.value = sel ? sel.map((px) => scale.invert(px)) : null;
      root.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
    });
    b.g.call(b.brush);
  }
  return root;
}
```

```{ojs}
legend = series === "earthquake" || market
  ? swatchLegend([
      { color: palette.active, label: `During: ${indicatorSpec.label}` },
      { color: palette.inactive, label: "Outside the indicator" }
    ])
  : ""
htl.html`<div>${view === "Line" ? planetLegend(planets) : ""}${legend}</div>`
```

```{ojs}
span = brushSel || [dateFrom, dateTo]
inSpan = events.filter((d) => d.date >= span[0] && d.date <= span[1])
activeTime = windows.reduce((s, { a, b }) => {
  const lo = Math.max(+a, +span[0]), hi = Math.min(+b, +span[1]);
  return s + Math.max(0, hi - lo);
}, 0)
readout = {
  const total = +span[1] - +span[0];
  const nIn = inSpan.filter((d) => d.active).length, nOut = inSpan.length - nIn;
  const share = total > 0 ? activeTime / total : NaN;
  const known = windows.length > 0 || series !== "earthquake";
  const ratio = known && share > 0 && share < 1 && nOut > 0
    ? (nIn / share) / (nOut / (1 - share)) : NaN;
  const fmt = d3.utcFormat("%Y-%m-%d");
  return htl.html`<p class="af-caption">
    <strong>${fmt(span[0])} to ${fmt(span[1])}</strong>${brushSel ? " (brushed)" : ""}:
    ${inSpan.length} events, ${nIn} during the indicator and ${nOut} outside.
    ${known ? `The indicator is active ${(100 * share).toFixed(1)}% of this span, so the descriptive rate ratio is ${Number.isFinite(ratio) ? ratio.toFixed(2) : "n/a"}.`
            : "Moon-mandala windows change about daily and are not drawn; each event still carries its state."}
    This is a description of the selection, not the registered test.</p>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
wheel = {
  if (view !== "Polar wheel") return htl.html``;
  const at = span[1];
  const r = [...monthIdx].reverse().find((m) => m.date <= at) || monthIdx[monthIdx.length - 1];
  if (!r) return htl.html`<p class="af-notice">No month in range.</p>`;
  const pos = planets.map((id) => ({ id, lon: eph.columns[id][r.i], retro: eph.columns[id + "_r"][r.i] === 1 }));
  return htl.html`<div class="af-chart" id="sky-wheel">${zodiacWheel(pos, {
    palette, size: Math.min(460, width), caption: r.date.toISOString().slice(0, 7)
  })}${planetLegend(planets)}</div>`;
}
```

## The registered test for this indicator

```{ojs}
gauge = {
  if (series !== "earthquake") {
    return htl.html`<p class="af-notice">The market studies test a difference in
      next-day returns, not an event rate; see the
      <a href="effects.html">indicator effects explorer</a> for those results.</p>`;
  }
  const pick = (period) => res.effects.find((d) => d.study === "earthquake"
    && d.indicator === indicator && d.group === catalogue && d.period === period);
  const cells = ["explore", "confirm"].map((p) => {
    const d = pick(p);
    const label = `${p === "explore" ? "1976-2010" : "2011-2026"}, ${catalogue.toUpperCase()}${d && d.q != null ? `, q = ${d.q.toFixed(2)}` : ""}`;
    return d ? hazardGauge({ rr: d.effect, lo: d.lo, hi: d.hi, label, palette })
             : htl.html`<p class="af-notice">No ${p} test for this catalogue.</p>`;
  });
  return htl.html`<div class="af-chart" id="sky-gauge" style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:1rem">${cells}</div>`;
}
```
